title: Art style (anima/lora_dataset/art-style.json)
description: Art style patterns for Anima Aesthetic v1.1 LoRA dataset prompts. Tags: lowercase, spaces instead of underscores. Artist tags need the @ prefix. Empty or omitted patterns emit one row without art style tags.

patterns.description: One generated row per pattern, after pose. Empty or omitted emits one row without art style tags. positive is used in positive_prompt and caption_prompt; negative is used in negative_prompt only. No (tag:weight) attention syntax.

name.description: Stable identifier; used in filename_prefix. When positive is omitted or empty, name is the sole positive tag.
